title: Truncated Text Overshoots the Max Length
description:
`truncate_with_ellipsis(text, max_len)` should return `text` unchanged if it's already at or under `max_len`, otherwise cut it down and append `"..."` so the **total** length is exactly `max_len`. Right now the result comes out longer than `max_len` whenever text is truncated. Find the bug and fix it so every hidden test passes.

**Function signature**
`truncate_with_ellipsis(text: str, max_len: int) -> str`

**Example**
`truncate_with_ellipsis("hello world", 8)` -> `"hello..."` (8 characters total).
